name: rss-keyword-monitor
description: Run bounded, on-demand searches of public RSS, Atom, and RDF feeds.

interface.longDescription: Search public RSS, Atom, or RDF feed URLs supplied by the user using keywords, regular expressions, exclusions, and field selection. Searches are on demand and capped at 100 results.
defaultPrompt: Search these public RSS feeds for AI stories and return at most 10 results.
Find up to 10 regular-expression matches in these public Atom feeds.
Search this public feed while excluding sports items and return at most 10 results.
